chunks: "Whoever performs hajj with three of the believers has purchased his soul from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for the price, and He will not ask him from where he earned his wealth, whether from halal or haram."

key_terms.اشْتَرَى: purchased, meaning secured deliverance at a price
key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One from Whom this reward is granted
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers who are the recipients of this act
key_terms.حَجَّ: performed hajj or enabled the hajj act mentioned in the narration

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for enabling three believers to perform hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the immense merit of taking or enabling three believers to perform hajj. It describes this act as a means of ransom and divine acceptance so great that the person is not questioned about the source of his wealth, whether halal or haram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2208 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) said:

"Whoever facilitates Hajj for three believers has purchased their soul from Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, at its price, and Allah (swt) will not question them about how they earned their wealth, whether it was lawful or unlawful."
